rv.q: This Les Misérables brings a healthy dose of l’optimisme millénaire to the stage.

Olney has brought into being a true masterpiece of classic theater that will delight the fans of the classic story and beautiful music, yet will also challenge you to see les misérables in your own life.
If there were a group to do the show justice, they are live on stage in Olney, Maryland.

cn.t: Olney's *Les Mis* earns mostly strong reviews for powerhouse performances and innovative design, though direction draws criticism. Two of three critics praise the production's fresh spirit; one finds the staging befuddling despite undeniable star power.
